title: dupatya minarum
intro: Dupatya minarum, commonly known as Indian valerian or Indian valerian root, is a plant species native to tropical Asia. It is a type of flowering plant in the family Valerianaceae, valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Dupatya minarum include its ability to act as a natural sedative, reducing anxiety and stress levels, and promoting a good night's sleep. The bioactive constituents of this plant include valerenic acid, isovaleric acid, and valepotriates, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as sedation, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties.
